title: Recent Customer Skips on a Re-sized Tailwise Autoship
content:
Customer-requested skips take days off the covered days of an existing Tailwise Autoship being re-sized to its own pet's usage (a non-prescription Autoship that has been carrying food for more than one pet of the household).

**Clause.** Two or more skips the customer requested on the subscription in the last six months take 4 days off; exactly one takes 2 days off; none takes no days off.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Customer-requested skips on the subscription, last six months | Days off the covered days |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 |
| exactly 1 | 2 |
| none | none |

**Hypothetical record.** One customer skip four months ago and one nine months ago: one in the period, 2 days off. Automatic backorder skips are not customer-requested and do not count.
